Project info
Name of project: Ekival: Pioneering Decentralized P2P Crypto-Fiat Exchange

Project URL: https://ekival.com/ and https://milestones.projectcatalyst.io/projects/1100123 

Fund Category: Cardano Use Cases: Concept

Project Number: 1100123

Name of project manager: Frédéric Samvura

Date project started: Mar 11, 2024

Date project completed: April 2026

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Development Milestones
・Completion of core functionalities,:
・ChatTrade system
・Live buyer-seller communication
・Maker/Taker order lifecycle
・Reference Script with Smart Contract integration
・Trade State and Offer parameters (expiration, fees, dispute stage, etc.) on-chain via inline datum
・Live reputation indicators
・

・Successful integration with major Cardano wallets and verification (JWT).
・UTxO parsing and optimization for transaction building and submission (Lucid + MeshSDK)
・Latest Plutus implementation in our smart contracts

Impact Potential
・Safer P2P transactions
・Lower costs
・Global accessibility
・Diaspora liquidity opportunity

Key Challenges
Challenge 1: Transaction Handling — Apollo Library & Plutus V2
The Apollo library helped bridge a gap: constructing Cardano transactions programmatically with Plutus V2 scripts. We essentially had to build a custom transaction engine, not just calling a blockchain API.
Impact on Ekival:
・Risk of malformed transactions which could have led to failed trades
・Harder debugging (on-chain failure reasons are not always transparent)
・Increased dev time for every new feature involving smart contracts

Challenge 2: Migration from Plutus V2 to V3
This is a structural challenge, not just an upgrade as Plutus V3 introduces:
・New script contexts
・Different cost models
・Potential changes in datum/redeemer handling
・Compatibility shifts with tooling

We had already deployed and tested on V2, so we had to migrate, which required rewriting and re-auditing the smart contracts for optimization based on V3.
